title: Phase 6 publish reconciliation DTO boundary cleanup
summary: Migrates the publish reconciliation DTO imports from the desktop compatibility export to the existing core DTO inventory owner and removes the matching temporary boundary allowlist rows.
reason: Phase 6 boundary cleanup is reducing remaining core-to-desktop imports in bounded DTO-only slices so later publish cleanup can focus on higher-risk drain and manifest behavior separately.
behavior_before: Publish reconciliation facade and policy imported PublishReconciliationDto through mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto, producing two allowlisted NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP findings.
behavior_after: Publish reconciliation facade and policy import PublishReconciliationDto from mediapipeline.core.kernel.dto_inventory while the desktop DTO module remains a compatibility export; the two allowlist rows are removed.
manual_validation: PASS: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.check_dependency_boundaries --format json --report-only (hard_findings=62, allowlisted=62, unallowlisted=0, unused_allowlist=0, NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP=45; domains: completed=4, config=8, processes=9, publish=7, queue=8, schedule=1, status=8)
rollback_plan: Restore the two publish reconciliation imports to mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto, restore the two removed allowlist rows, refresh the two generated summaries, and mark AB-PUB-014/AB-PUB-016 open again in the edge ledger.
notes:
DTO-only import ownership change. No Local API routes, WebView commands, media policy, pending publish drain behavior, reconciliation matching logic, filesystem movement, route schemas, or operator behavior changed.
Move PublishReconciliationDto import from desktop compatibility export to core DTO inventory.
Remove migrated temporary NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP allowlist rows for publish reconciliation DTO imports.
Mark AB-PUB-014 and AB-PUB-016 migrated with core DTO ownership and removed allowlist action.
Refresh generated summary after publish reconciliation facade import ownership change.
Refresh generated summary after publish reconciliation policy import ownership change.
